Then at one point, I started to lose money and in order to not lose my account, he told me that I must invest more. Then they told me I can withdraw my money but after the head of the department, Dimitris called me and said I was only allowed to withdraw 7000‚Ç¨ out of the full amount (164,000). When I asked him when I can withdraw the rest, he said that I have to make more movements on my account which meant approximately a year later. When I agreed with it they started to tell me I have to pay different fees and taxes in order to be able to withdraw.
